purpose: Predeclared conditional financial-engine inputs for the report repair; not user-approved investment assumptions or observed future probabilities.
data_policy: Retain the November5,2026 snapshot; fit only501 completed adjusted closes/500 returns throughNovember4. No private accounts, stock refresh or fabricated measurements.
engine_policy: Use the actual installed frozen Capital Decision Lab analysis/engines. Preserve raw cases, output atoms, formula refs, canonical hashes and module-source identity. No replacement implementations for production Sharpe/Kelly/convexity outputs.

historical_sharpe.benchmark_classification: modeled constant cash benchmark, not measured Treasury yield
historical_sharpe.definition: Native mean excess daily return / population daily standard deviation times sqrt252; not serial-correlation-adjusted or a forward Sharpe forecast.

conditional_input_model.cross_sectional_policy: Same sampled contiguous block indices across all5 names; blocks sampled with replacement.
conditional_input_model.probability_policy: Empirical positive/negative terminal-return fractions are conditional on this historical-resampling model, not calibrated stock win odds. Handle exact-zero mass explicitly; never invent a missing loss tail.
conditional_input_model.kelly_payoffs: Conditional mean positive and negative modeled terminal returns; binary compression omits within-state variability.
conditional_input_model.convexity_states: All negative samples form bear. Positive samples split by sorted counts into lower50%, next40%, top10% (base/bull/moon). Each state uses its conditional mean and actual count/trials probability; preserve total mean and probability mass.
conditional_input_model.limits: In-sample history reuse, stationarity, block-length choice, limited2-year data, estimation error, no valuation or independent forecast calibration; not an independent evidence family. Four-state dispersion/log growth is not the full bootstrap distribution.

kelly_reference_assumptions.authority: Illustrative analyst/model choices, not user chosen, confirmed or authorized. References for five names are not an additive feasible allocation. No borrowing or trades.

comparison_policy: Retain original risk-only $1,000 targets and equal-dollar benchmark as comparisons, never relabel them Kelly allocations. Distinguish newly calculated conditional references from validated sizing authorization.
commentary_policy: After parent verification, every simulated200-word lens must receive the same extended financial-engine packet and distinguish calculation from model validity. Existing baseline packet remains immutable.
